search_products.description: Search Best Buy for a query; read every result card (price, Comp. Value, more-options-from price, shipping / pickup / unavailable messages, rating). Read-only.
steps: search_via=form: bring the bound tab to the front; wheel up to search_box if needed; type_cdp the query into search_box (textarea; click, clear, insertText); check it holds exactly the query and search_submit is visible and uncovered; CDP-click search_submit (never the Clear button next to it).
If typing can't reach the page (hidden tab) the same search is opened by URL (/site/searchpage.jsp?st=<query>) and the page records it.
Wait for a results page whose st= is the query, with result_card.
Read down with wheel flicks to the page end (cards render only when scrolled into view), then read every result_card.
Stop on a robot check / access-denied page (Blocked).
search_products.evidence: Each card has a SKU and a title; a price is read or the card is marked unavailable; availability comes from the card's own shipping / pickup / unavailable messages.
